comments.note: All 5 files are clean, minimal, and correct. One-concept-per-file layout, consistent namespace VideoIndexer.App.Services.Navigation, sealed records appropriate for immutable value-like types.

IReadOnlyList<T> return type on Destinations and BreadcrumbItems is the correct choice — allows implementations to back the collection with ObservableCollection<T> while exposing a read-only contract. EventHandler<PrimaryDestination?>? correctly uses a nullable generic delegate to signal 'no active destination' on deselection.

PrimaryDestination.RootViewModel is typed as 'object'. This is consistent with Avalonia's ViewLocator approach (which also takes object) and avoids constraining the VM hierarchy. Future contributors should be aware that PrimaryDestination instances are meant to carry live ViewModel instances created at registration time.
No reviewer-applied fixes necessary. All interface members and record shapes exactly match the plan spec. No blocking issues.
